scripts.ci: npm run ci:gate && npm run ci:wasm && npm run ci:tauri && npm run ci:web
scripts.ci:wasm: cargo clippy -p sheetsift-wasm --all-targets --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo test -p sheetsift-core --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo test -p sheetsift-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.ci:web: npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run check
scripts.ci:tauri: cargo clippy --manifest-path crates/tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path crates/tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev:web: npm run pkg && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run pkg && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.pkg: cargo build -p sheetsift-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sheetsift_wasm.wasm
